Electron density ne=10¹⁹ × 10^(log g−4.44) × 5772/T m⁻³ is an explicit schematic pressure proxy, not a calibrated atmosphere. Doppler b²=2kT/m+ξ²; the area-normalized opacity is broadened before transfer. Only instrumental broadening is a subsequent convolution. No line emission, damping, real atmosphere, NLTE or 3D prediction. Slider bounds define the teaching domain, not an interpolation grid.
